digest.component_or_area: ticket store snapshot entries and reducer cache
propositions: Snapshot ticket entries documented as immutable content-addressed stores are being written to during read operations via .cache.json cache files created by reducer calls
Every show_ticket read through a pinned root calls write_cache which atomically writes .cache.json inside the snapshot entry directory, violating immutability guarantees
Hardlinked blob-sharing between adjacent entries becomes unsafe if the atomic_write publication method ever switches from os.replace to in-place write, risking silent inode corruption
The reverify_entry baseline digest becomes outdated when reads add .cache.json files post-materialization, causing entries to appear corrupt on subsequent verification passes
Snapshot entries accumulate thousands of post-build cache artifact files that are gitignored and absent from the committed tree, inflating store size
